notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
-Improved performance
-Corrected collision of construction windows, when the drone could not fly into the construction window.
-Removed the second delay required to pick up the juice.
-Optimized loading, the first time you enter the game
-Redesigned Stagger, now you can immediately do a roll after a stan.
-Improved target targeting, removed the delay before switching targets.
-Added a wall where the player could sprgodnuyu behind the map

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
